title: Liquidity Risk Reporting - Assistant Vice President
description:
Join Barclays as a Liquidity Risk Reporting \- Assistant Vice President role, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:
   

  

  

* Knowledge of the liquidity regulatory metric calculation methodologies (in particular LCR, NSFR, PRA110, ALMM) and underlying drivers.
* Must have strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent presentation skills.
* Excellent Microsoft Excel skills.
* Strong Balance sheet and Finance skills.
* Strong understanding of Control and Governance frameworks.
* Experience in driving change initiatives including working with IT on automation initiatives.
* Excellent relationship management skills, with an ability to develop and maintain strong, open and trusted relationships with a variety of stakeholders outside of the immediate team.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**
* Experience within a Liquidity (Risk) Management function.
* Some/Preferred experience in data visualisation (e.g. Qlik, Tableau, Hypercube) and coding (e.g. SQL, Python, R).
* Working knowledge of data mining / automation tools (SQL, VBA).
* Degree educated with a relevant qualification (ACA, CFA).
* Regulatory and/or consultancy background.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based out of Chennai location.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To verify that the bank has sufficient funds to meet its short\-term and long\-term obligations, and the development and implementation of strategies to manage the bank's liquidity position.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of funding and liquidity strategies to efficiently manage the bank’s liquidity position within regulatory requirements and risk appetite at favourable commercial outcomes with respect to funding costs.
* Analysis and quantification of the regulatory and behavioural liquidity risk impact of transactions undertaken by business units.
* Maintenance of strong relationships with key business units and working with the business units to manage liquidity to within constrains.
* Monitoring of key liquidity metrics and trends and advising on actions to be taken to maintain funding and liquidity levels within tolerance.
* Managing intra\-group funding arrangements to ensure subsidiaries are adequately funded and managed within balance sheet, large exposure and capital constraints.
* Design and implementation of stress testing methodologies to assess the bank's liquidity resilience under various financial shocks, economic downturns, and sector\-specific crises, and analysis of stress testing results and development of mitigation strategies to address potential liquidity shortfalls.
* Development of new tools, models and data analysis to support and enhance the bank’s funding and liquidity management capabilities.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

**Process Overview\***
 CFO is a risk\-based program to identify \& confirm data gaps in various high risk financial regulatory reports filed by the bank like FR\- Y\-9C, FR\- Y\-15, FFIEC 031/041, FFIEC 009, FFIEC 101, COREP, FINREP \& AnaCredit \& Liquidity Reports. The team also forms an integral part of the remediation work required for MRA raised by FRB for Regulatory Reports filed by the bank.

 Executing assessments to review and validate source documents, data source elements and logic adheres to specified business and/or data regulatory requirements

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 CA/CPA, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 1 \- 2 years’ experience
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Exposure to US regulatory reports such as FRY\-9C, FRY\-14Q/M, FFIEC031, FRY\-15, FFIEC 009 or EMEA regulatory reports like COREP, FINREP \& AnaCredit.

title: Specialist, Fixed Assets
description:
Requisition Number: 20382
   

  

 Contract Type: Permanent
   

  

 Location(s):
   

  

 Chennai, IN
   

  

**Specialist, Fixed Assets**
**Role Description Summary**
 The Fixed Assets Specialist is responsible for managing the end\-to\-end accounting lifecycle of fixed assets, including capitalization, transfers, disposals, depreciation, and reconciliation activities in compliance with accounting standards (IFRS/GAAP), company policy, and internal controls (including SOX). This role will support ongoing integration into S/4HANA, onboarding of new companies, audit compliance, and fixed asset reporting. The individual must have strong accounting acumen, a proactive compliance mindset, and a data\-focused approach to ensure timely and accurate asset management across entities.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas**
* Maintain and manage the Fixed Asset Register, ensuring accurate recording of acquisitions, capitalizations, retirements, transfers, and adjustments.
* Execute monthly depreciation runs and ensure alignment with accounting standards and useful life policies.
* Perform fixed asset reconciliations (FA subledger vs GL), investigate variances, and drive timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Support fixed asset physical verification exercises and tagging in collaboration with business units.
* Ensure timely closure of Construction in Progress (CIP) and proper classification of assets as per capitalization policy.
* Review and validate asset additions against Capex approvals and ensure policy compliance before posting to the ledger.
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation for all asset\-related activities and support both internal and external audit requirements.
* Monitor and report on SOX and internal control compliance through dashboards, identifying risks and taking corrective actions.
* Support fixed asset process design and data migration during S/4HANA integrations and onboarding of new entities.
* Collaborate with the business, project teams, and accounting to ensure timely closure of open items and smooth period\-end processing.
* Manage GR/IR clearing and reconciliations, ensuring timely follow\-ups with relevant teams for resolution
* Manage end\-to\-end lease accounting activities in compliance with IFRS 16
* Leases including initial recognition, right\-of\-use (ROU), asset amortization, interests, lease liabilities, and modifications.
* Prepare monthly lease accounting entries, including depreciation of ROU assets and interest accretion on lease liabilities.


 COMPETENCIES
   

  

* Detail Orientation \& Accuracy: Maintains meticulous asset records and ensures high precision in all postings and reconciliations.
* Accounting \& Compliance Focus: Strong grasp of fixed asset accounting principles, with an ability to enforce policies and controls.
* Time \& Process Discipline: Delivers tasks under tight timelines, especially during month\-end and year\-end periods.
* Analytical \& Reporting Abilities: Skilled in reviewing data, identifying gaps, and producing compliance or asset performance dashboards.
* Collaboration \& Issue Resolution: Coordinates with stakeholders (e.g., project teams, controllers) to close exceptions proactively.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance; CA Inter or equivalent preferred.
* ERP Knowledge: Experience in S/4HANA Asset Accounting (FI\-AA) module is essential.
* Accounting Standards: Familiarity with IFRS/GAAP for asset capitalization, impairment, depreciation, lease liability, ROU and interest.
* Technical Tools: Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with automation tools, scripts, or dashboarding is an added advantage.
* Work Experience: 8–10 years of relevant experience in Fixed Asset Accounting, preferably within a shared services or corporate environment with audit exposure.

title: Principal Treasury Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. If you are passionate about building energy's future and want to be considered when this role becomes available, we encourage you to submit your details.
   

  

**Job Overview**
 The Principal Treasury Analyst – FX \& Hedging is responsible for supporting the Company's global foreign exchange risk management program, executing and administering hedging strategies, monitoring currency exposures, and ensuring compliance with treasury policies and accounting requirements. The role partners closely with business units, accounting, FP\&A, tax, and regional finance teams to identify, quantify, manage, and report foreign exchange risks. The position plays a critical role in protecting the organization from adverse currency movements through the use of financial derivatives and natural hedging strategies while supporting cash flow forecasting, hedge accounting, and treasury technology initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**
* Manage and monitor global foreign exchange exposures, including transactional, translational, and forecasted currency risks across business units and regions.
* Execute and administer FX hedging strategies using approved derivative instruments such as forwards, swaps, options, and NDFs in accordance with Treasury Policy.
* Partner with FP\&A, accounting, tax, and regional finance teams to identify exposures, improve forecast accuracy, and support risk mitigation strategies.
* Perform quantitative analysis and scenario modeling to evaluate the potential financial impact of currency market movements on earnings, cash flow, and balance sheet exposures.
* Support hedge accounting compliance by preparing documentation, assisting with effectiveness testing, and coordinating closely with accounting teams under ASC 815 or IFRS 9 requirements.
* Monitor financial markets, economic trends, and geopolitical developments to assess potential impacts on foreign exchange risks and recommend appropriate actions.
* Prepare treasury risk reports, dashboards, and management presentations covering FX exposures, hedge performance, market conditions, and key risk metrics.
* Maintain Treasury Management System (TMS) data and controls, ensuring accurate reporting, trade capture, valuation, settlement, and compliance with internal policies.
* Manage banking and counterparty relationships associated with FX trading activities in Bloomberg, including monitoring approved limits, documentation, and service performance.
* Drive treasury process improvements, automation initiatives, and internal control enhancements to strengthen risk management, operational efficiency, and SOX compliance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field
* CTP, or other treasury\-related certification preferred 5–8\+ years of treasury, corporate finance, or risk management experience
* Strong experience with foreign exchange risk management and derivatives
* Experience supporting hedge accounting programs
* Experience within a multinational corporation preferred
* Experience using Treasury Management Systems (e.g. FIS Quantum, Kyriba, GTreasury)
* Must be able to perform effectively under tight deadlines with multiple priorities
* Must be team oriented and able to thrive in a fast paced, changing environment


**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description:
About Amadora and this role
 



 Amadora is a premium artisanal ice cream brand founded in Chennai in 2011\. Everything is made from scratch, with no premixes, in our central kitchen. We run 19 franchise and company\-owned stores across Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad, with about 20 more planned for 2027 across Karnataka, Kerala and Andhra Pradesh. Our range covers ice cream, bars, cakes, sandwiches, baked goods and sauces.
 



 We are hiring our first Financial Controller to own Amadora's numbers end to end. You will build the finance function that carries us from 19 to 40\+ stores across five states: systems, controls, reporting and planning. This is a CFO\-track role. As the function matures over 18–24 months, you will take on capital, investor and strategic finance, and grow into Amadora's CFO.
 



 Key responsibilities
 



**Reporting and MIS** 



* Own monthly MIS: store\-wise, franchise\-wise, factory and head\-office P\&Ls.
* Run and sign off the month\-end close, with a target of 7 working days.
* Build dashboards on unit economics, gross margin, food cost and channel mix (dine\-in, Swiggy, Zomato, quick commerce).



**Systems and controls** 



* Lead the ERP selection and rollout (Odoo or Zoho, integrated with Petpooja POS) as the finance owner.
* Design and enforce controls across purchasing, inventory, stock transfers, cash handling and approvals.
* Set up inventory valuation and reconciliation between factory, hubs and stores.



**Tax and compliance** 



* Own multi\-state GST, interstate stock transfers, e\-way bills, TDS and statutory compliance, executed with the Head of Accounts.
* Manage statutory and internal audits end to end.



**Franchise finance** 



* Own franchise billing, royalty and supply invoicing, collections and receivables.
* Build a P\&L view per franchisee to spot struggling stores early.



**Planning and cash** 



* Run the annual budget, monthly budget\-vs\-actual reviews, and a rolling 13\-week cash flow forecast.
* Build financial models for new cities, new stores and capex (including the next factory).
* Manage banking relationships and working capital.



**Team** 



* Lead the accounts team; hire and develop as the function grows.



 Qualifications and experience
 


* Chartered Accountant (CA), 6–9 years post\-qualification.
* At least 3–4 years in industry finance, ideally in multi\-location retail, QSR, F\&B or FMCG. Franchise\-model exposure is a strong plus.
* Hands\-on experience owning MIS, store or branch P\&Ls, and the month\-end close.
* Has been the finance lead on at least one ERP implementation (Odoo, Zoho, SAP B1, Tally Prime to ERP migration or similar).
* Working knowledge of multi\-state GST, stock transfers, e\-way bills and TDS.
* Strong Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Audit background (Big 4 or mid\-tier) is welcome, but must be combined with real industry experience.



 Competencies
 


* **Builder mindset.** 
 Comfortable creating systems and processes from scratch, not just running existing ones.
* **Ownership.** 
 Treats the numbers as their own and is accountable for accuracy and timeliness.
* **Hands\-on.** 
 Willing to do the work personally while the team and systems are being built.
* **Commercial judgement.** 
 Reads a P\&L like an operator and connects numbers to store and factory decisions.
* **Clear communicator.** 
 Explains finance plainly to franchisees, operations leads and the MD.
* **Integrity and discipline.** 
 Holds the line on controls, even under pressure to move fast.



 What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)
 


* The ERP is live and integrated with Petpooja, covering finance, inventory and franchise billing.
* Month\-end close runs in 7 working days or less, with accurate store\-wise, franchise\-wise, factory and head\-office P\&Ls every month.
* Multi\-state GST, stock transfers and e\-way bills run cleanly across all operating states, with no material compliance issues.
* Franchise royalties and supply invoices are billed on time, and receivables are tracked and within agreed terms.
* A 13\-week rolling cash flow forecast and the annual budget are in place, with monthly budget\-vs\-actual reviews.
* Financial models for the 2027 store rollout and the next factory are built and used in leadership decisions.



 Growth path and how to apply
 



 In year two, the role expands into strategic finance: capital planning, factory financing, investor reporting and fundraising. The goal is for this person to become Amadora's CFO within 18–24 months, based on performance.
 



 To apply, send your CV and a short note on a finance system you built from scratch to jobs@amadora.in, with "Financial Controller" in the subject line.

title: Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation Lead
description:
**About Us**




  





 As a leading provider of high\-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across \~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant\-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy\-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep\-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  




* Handling of Group Consolidation \& Reporting
* Own and lead monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidation of Group Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements, including sub\-consolidations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Establish and manage a robust close calendar covering entity submissions, consolidation activities, and reporting timelines.
* Perform detailed Financial statement reviews, identifying risk areas, mismatches, and movements, and provide clear insights to management.
* Coordinate preparation of consolidated financial reports and statutory reporting packs; support external financial disclosures as required.
* Collaborate closely with Corporate Secretariat, FP\&A, and Group Controller teams to ensure alignment between internal and external reporting, including financial and non\-financial KPIs.
* Act as process owner for consolidation system implementation and enhancements.
* Partner with IT and SAP CoE to drive automation, system upgrades, data integration, and process efficiencies between source systems and reporting platforms.
* Lead troubleshooting and continuous process improvements, effectively bridging gaps between origin and corporate finance.
* Strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks around consolidation and financial statement.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on IFRS, providing guidance, training, and supporting change management initiatives.
* Lead interactions with Group and country\-level auditors; manage audit documentation, technical accounting assessments, and timely resolution of audit queries.
* Handle critical accounting matters with sound technical judgment, including complex estimates and disclosures.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high\-performing consolidation team; provide coaching and support career development.
* Partner with local Finance Controllers, Treasury, Tax, IT, and senior leadership to align objectives and drive continuous improvement across finance operations.
* Support mergers, acquisitions, liquidations, and due diligence activities, including PPA, goodwill, and integration of new entities into consolidation systems.



  





**Experience and Qualification**




  




* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 14\+ years of post\-qualification experience (preferably qualified in 2012 or earlier), including a minimum of 8 years in group consolidation and reporting roles.
* Strong expertise in IFRS and related accounting standards, with hands\-on application in complex group structures.
* Advanced knowledge of consolidation tools such as SAP BPC, HFM, or other established consolidation systems.
* Deep understanding of SAP systems, consolidation modules, system integration, and data governance to drive automation and reporting efficiency.
* Proven experience in consolidating 100\+ legal entities across multiple geographies, including multi\-currency environments, revaluation, and foreign currency translation.
* Demonstrated experience working in large, listed organizations with complex reporting and governance requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a clear focus on process improvement and operational excellence.
* Experience in mergers and acquisitions integration, including onboarding of new entities into consolidation systems, is a strong advantage.
* Strong leadership capabilities, including team management, ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment, and consistently meet tight deadlines.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with Finance, IT, auditors, and regional controllers.
* Proactive mindset with a track record of driving automation, efficiency, and adoption of finance best practices.

title: FP&A Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
 The Financial Planning \& Appraisal Manager is accountable for enabling high\-quality business decisions through robust planning, performance management, appraisal, forecasting and decision ready insight generation. The role acts as a strategic finance partner to business and finance leadership, translating commercial drivers, operational performance, risks and opportunities into clear financial insights and actionable interventions. The role is expected to strengthen decision quality, drive value delivery, maintain financial discipline and accelerate the shift from reporting to providing forward\-looking decision ready insights through data, digital and analytics\-enabled ways of working.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a commercially minded finance leader who combines strong FP\&A fundamentals with curiosity, digital fluency and the ability to influence senior stakeholders. They are comfortable operating in ambiguity, translating complex business information into clear recommendations, and leading teams through change. They bring a disciplined focus on value, risk, controls and performance, while continuously partnering with business to enable competitive decision quality, business strategy \& performance.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Lead integrated planning and forecasting: Own and coordinate planning, latest estimate and appraisal processes, ensuring assumptions, financial outcomes and business drivers are transparent, consistent and aligned with business strategy.
* Drive performance management: Monitor financial and operational performance against targets/benchmarks, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and support timely interventions to drive competitive performance.
* Provide business appraisal and decision support: Apply value and risk lenses to investment, portfolio, commercial and operational decisions, ensuring options are evaluated with sound financial logic and business judgement.
* Generate actionable options and recommendations: Leverage automated analytics dashboards to convert data, trends and scenarios into clear options, decision\-ready recommendations and practical interventions that support senior leadership decision\-making.
* Strengthen financial discipline and controls: Ensure planning, reporting and appraisal activities comply with governance, control, assurance and financial reporting requirements.
* Partner across the business: Build trusted relationships with business leaders, finance colleagues and cross\-functional stakeholders to align priorities, challenge constructively and influence better decisions.
* Enable digital and analytics transformation: Champion automation, self\-service reporting, driver\-based modelling, scenario planning and predictive analytics to improve speed, quality and efficiency of finance delivery.
* Develop capability and talent: Coach and develop team members, build future\-ready FP\&A capabilities and foster a learner mindset across business partnering, data, digital, analytics and process excellence.
* Transformation \& Continuous Improvement: Drive simplification, automation, digitisation and process improvement across planning \& appraisal activities, leveraging technology, analytics and AI\-enabled tools where appropriate.
* AI\-enabled FP\&A governance and decision support: Review, interpret and leverage outputs from AI\-enabled tools to deliver high\-quality FP\&A support, ensuring insights, forecasts and recommendations are grounded in robust assumptions, strong data integrity, sound judgement and disciplined AI risk management and governance.


**What You Bring**
* Business partnering and commercial acumen: Ability to understand value drivers, business models, market dynamics and operational levers, and convert them into practical financial advice.
* Financial performance management: Strong capability in KPI design, target setting, variance analysis, forecasting, performance appraisal and intervention planning.
* Planning and financial decision\-making: Ability to coordinate business planning, translate strategy into financial targets and link plans to milestones, actions and measurable outcomes.
* Financial modelling and scenario analysis: Experience in driver\-based modelling, sensitivity \& scenario analysis, risk and opportunity framing, business cases and investment appraisal.
* Data analytics and insights: Ability to validate, analyse and interpret data; identify patterns and trends; and generate insights that answer business questions and improve decision quality.
* Data management and digital acumen: Understanding of data quality, governance, reporting automation, dashboarding, analytics tools and digital solutions that improve finance processes with ability to work with AI.
* Storytelling and strategic executive communication: Ability to convert complex analysis into clear, concise and compelling messages for senior stakeholders, including recommendations and decision asks.
* Process excellence and continuous improvement: Ability to simplify, standardise and improve finance processes while maintaining governance, control and operational discipline.
* Stakeholder management and influencing: Ability to build trust, challenge constructively, navigate ambiguity and influence outcomes across functions, geographies and leadership levels.
* Change leadership: Ability to lead through transformation, adopt new ways of working, build engagement and embed sustainable improvements.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Operate as a trusted finance advisor and strategic co\-pilot to the business.
* Demonstrate courage to challenge assumptions, surface risks and recommend value\-accretive actions.
* Lead with clarity, accountability and care, enabling a high\-performing and inclusive team environment.
* Build capability by coaching others, sharing best practices and contributing to communities of practice.
* Balance enterprise value, risk, controls and business pragmatism in decision support.
* Role\-model learner mindset, digital curiosity and adaptability in a fast\-evolving finance environment.


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Significant experience in financial planning, appraisal, performance management, business finance or related finance roles.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior business stakeholders to influence decisions and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, value drivers, planning cycles, forecasting, business case development and performance reporting.
* Experience leading teams or influencing cross\-functional delivery through matrixed ways of working.
* Experience with digital finance tools, data visualisation, automation, analytics or driver\-based planning solutions is highly desirable.
* Professional finance qualification, accounting qualification, MBA or relevant business/finance degree preferred.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Timely, accurate and value\-adding delivery of planning, LE, appraisal and performance management cycles.
* Improved decision quality through clear insights, robust scenarios and transparent assumptions.
* Visible business impact from interventions, performance actions and value/risk\-based recommendations.
* Increased efficiency and effectiveness through simplification, automation and digital adoption.
* Strong stakeholder confidence in finance advice, analysis and governance.
* Improved team capability across business partnering, data, digital, analytics, insights, decision quality and process excellence.


**What We Offer**
 You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
   

  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values\-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.


**An Inclusive \& Progressive Place to Work**
* To power progress together, we need to attract and develop the brightest minds and make sure every voice is heard. Here are just some of the ways we’re nurturing an inclusive environment – one where you can express your ideas, extend your skills, and reach your potential.
* We’re creating a space where people with disabilities can excel through transparent recruitment process, workplace adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Feel free to let us know about your circumstances when you apply, and we’ll take it from there.
* We’re closing the gender gap – whether that’s through action on equal pay or by enabling more women to reach senior roles in engineering and technology.
* We’re striving to be a pioneer of an inclusive and diverse workplace, promoting equality for employees regardless of sexual orientation or gender identity.


**Shell in India**
 Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R\&D, digitalisation, and business operations.
   

  

 Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net\-zero emissions energy business by 2050\. As India moves towards its target of net\-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
   

  

 Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end\-to\-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world\-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350\-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
   

  

 Shell owns and operates a LNG re\-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck\-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1\.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
   

  

 Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting\-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
   

  

 We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco\-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

description:
**Position :** 

 Controller – Manufacturing Accounting
 

**Job Type :** 

 Contract \- 6 Months 
 




**Hours: :** 
 US Shift Timings (6\.30PM\-4\.00AM)
 
**Location** 

 :  HYBRID, Chennai
 




**ERP :** 

 Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
 

**Reports to** 

 : 
 
 CEO
 



  
 



**What You'll Do** 




**Cost accounting – the core of the job**



* Own the standard cost library: material, labor, and overhead rates. Run the periodic standards roll, document every assumption behind it, and defend the result.
* Analyze and report purchase price variance – what we paid against standard, by raw material, with the commentary that explains it.
* Own the manufacturing variance set: material usage and yield, labor efficiency, and overhead spending and absorption. Tie every variance back to a production run, not a plug.
* Reconcile costed bills of material and routings to actual consumption, and flag where the BOM no longer reflects how the line really runs.
* Value inventory across raw material, work in process, and finished goods, including reserves for excess, obsolete, and short\-dated stock.
* Reconcile cycle counts and physical inventory book\-to\-physical, investigate the differences, and clear them. A variance you cannot explain is an open item, not a rounding.
* Track the cost of quality: scrap, rework, product on hold and its release, lab and testing spend.
* Allocate freight\-in and landed cost to the right units.



**Margin, pricing, and profitability** 



* Produce customer and SKU\-level profitability by customer code name the



 analysis that tells our commercial team which business is actually earning its keep.
 


* Model toll rates against margin floors and blended targets, and give the margin read



 on customer quotes before they go out.
 


* Quantify and track cost\-out initiatives with Operations: identify them, size them, and report



 whether they actually landed.
 


* · Surface the financial risk you see in the numbers – raw material price movement, production



 variance trends, margin erosion, customer concentration.
 



**Close and reporting**



* · Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering P\&L, balance sheet, and cash
* flow within 7 business days of month\-end.
* ·  Reconcile every balance sheet account monthly, with supporting schedules retained and reviewable.
* ·  Maintain the chart of accounts and journal entry standards in Business Central.
* ·  Build the financial section of the monthly board package and the budget\-versus\-



 actual reporting behind it.
 


* · Write the variance commentary: what changed, why, whether it is temporary or structural,



 and what needs a decision.
 



**Controls, audit, and documentation**



* Prepare the full PBC package for our external audit and own the preparer\-side response cycle.
* Maintain the authorization limits framework, enforce segregation of duties



 and dual approvals, and escalate anything that bypassed them.
 


* Support sales and use tax, payroll tax oversight, 1099 and W\-9 administration, PACA



 license maintenance, and state grant reporting – prepared by you, filed by our U.S. team and advisors.
 


* · Write and maintain desk procedures for every recurring process you own. This is a



 standing expectation, not a one\-time project – we are explicitly trying to end the
 



 era of undocumented financ
 




 Team
 



* Give day\-to\-day technical direction to our Cost Accounting Manager and Staff Accountant on



 close deliverables, costing method, and reconciliation quality.
 


* Review their work and raise the standard of it. Formal HR matters reviews, compensation,



 discipline stay with the CEO and HR onsite.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 




**Required** 



* CPA or Chartered Accountant.
* · 0\+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3\+ years personally owning a



 full monthly close – running one, not supporting one.
 


* Hands\-on manufacturing cost accounting under a standard costing system. This is our



 screening requirement. You should be able to walk us through a purchase price variance and
 



 a yield variance you personally calculated, explained, and defended.
 


* · Inventory accounting across raw material, WIP, and finished goods, including reserves and



 physical\- count reconciliation.
 


* · A manufacturing ERP with a real costing module, used hands\-on – Dynamics 365 Business



 Central, Dynamics NAV or AX, SAP, Oracle, or NetSuite.
 


* Working U.S. GAAP fluency, including ASC 842 lease accounting.
* Business\-fluent written and spoken English. You will write directly to our CEO, our sponsor



 finance team, and our auditors, so written clarity is part of how we evaluate candidates.
 


* · The ability to work U.S. Central hours sustainably, including close weeks. We would rather



 you have worked this shift before than agree to try it.
 



**Preferred** 



* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central specifically – it is our system, and direct experience



 shortens your ramp considerably.
 


* Food, CPG, or USDA\-regulated manufacturing. Co\-manufacturing or contract manufacturing



 is even better.
 


* The controller is genuinely hands\-on rather than supervising a department.
* Audit PBC preparation as the preparer, working directly with a U.S. firm.
* Experience as the offshore counterpart to a U.S. finance team – you already understand the



 prepare\-here, approve\-there rhythm.
 


* A manufacturing execution system such as RedZone, or an EDI platform such as SPS Commerce.



**Nice to have** 



* · CMA or CGMA alongside your primary credential.
* · Turnaround, transition, or finance\-function build experience.
* ·  Multi\-plant or multi\-entity consolidation exposure.
* · Experience standing up finance documentation and SOPs where none existed.



 Interested Candidates can apply in
 **Linkedin** 
 or send a mail to S
 **tephen.Raphael@caligne.com**

title: Associate Vice President
description:
**Job Summary**
**Role Purpose**
* To provide strategic leadership and end\-to\-end oversight of Accounts Payable and Payment Operations within Organization, ensuring delivery of efficient, controlled, compliant, and customer\-centric services across the organization.
* The role is accountable for operational excellence, governance, risk management, payment controls, stakeholder engagement, process transformation, and people leadership. The Associate Vice President will lead multiple teams through senior managers and managers, drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthen the control environment, and ensure alignment with Standard Chartered strategic priorities, values, and risk culture.
* The role serves as a key partner to global stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Business functions to ensure sustainable operational performance, scalability, and service excellence.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and implementation of the P\-Card programme across approved markets, from business case and operating model through rollout and stabilisation.
* Translate the P\-Card strategy into a phased implementation roadmap with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, benefits, risks and accountable owners.
* Own delivery governance, including programme plans, steering updates, decision logs, risk and issue tracking, and timely escalation of delivery constraints.
* Define the target operating model covering card request, approval, issuance, activation, usage, expense submission, reconciliation, settlement, suspension and closure.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Technology, Information Security and business teams to deliver market\-ready solutions.
* Lead engagement with card issuers, expense\-platform providers and other external partners, ensuring service, control, data and implementation requirements are met.
* Develop and maintain P\-Card policies, standards, procedures, user guidance and control requirements aligned with organisational and local regulatory expectations.
* Establish robust maker\-checker controls, approval limits, merchant\-category restrictions, transaction limits and segregation of duties across the card lifecycle.
* Design preventive and detective controls for inappropriate spend, duplicate claims, split transactions, personal usage, cash withdrawal and other policy exceptions.
* Ensure cardholder, approver, administrator and programme\-owner responsibilities are clearly defined, communicated and evidenced.
* Oversee integration between the card issuer, expense\-management platform, procurement systems, enterprise resource planning systems and general ledger.
* Ensure accurate accounting, cost allocation, statement matching, settlement, reconciliation and month\-end reporting for P\-Card transactions.
* Define data, reporting and dashboard requirements covering spend, adoption, exceptions, ageing, delinquency, control breaches, savings and supplier coverage.
* Lead user acceptance testing, defect management, production\-readiness reviews, cutover planning and post\-implementation validation.
* Coordinate market onboarding, including local requirements assessment, stakeholder sign\-off, communications, training and hypercare support.
* Drive cardholder and approver adoption while maintaining appropriate eligibility criteria, approval discipline and spend governance.
* Act as the senior escalation point for implementation decisions, operational incidents, issuer performance, control gaps and complex stakeholder concerns.
* Ensure timely investigation, remediation and root\-cause analysis of failed transactions, unreconciled items, suspicious activity and policy breaches.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails for programme decisions, approvals, testing, controls, exceptions and issue remediation.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and risk assessments, ensuring actions are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Define service levels and performance measures for issuers, service teams and internal stakeholders, and lead regular governance reviews.
* Identify opportunities to increase compliant P\-Card usage, reduce low\-value purchase\-order and invoice volumes, and improve the employee and supplier experience.
* Deliver measurable benefits through process simplification, automation, improved visibility, reduced processing effort and stronger spend control.
* Plan resources and manage implementation capacity, budget and third\-party costs within approved parameters.
* Lead and develop the implementation team, promoting accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and strong risk ownership.
* Embed a sustainable business\-as\-usual model, including ownership, support arrangements, control monitoring, change management and continuous improvement.
* Embed resilience, access, data protection, fraud prevention and contingency controls in the programme design.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Advanced Accounts Payables Knowledge (E2E)
* Payment Operations \& Controls
* Financial Accounting \& Reconciliation
* Operational Risk Management
* Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
* Data Analytics \& Business Reporting
* Strategic Operations Management
* Stakeholder Management \& Influencing
* Change \& Transformation Leadership
* Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
* People Leadership \& Talent Development
* Resource and Capacity Planning


**Other Skills**
* AI and Automation Technologies
* ERP and Workflow Management Solutions
* SAP (VIM / S4 HANA / Ariba)


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences:**
* 12\+ years of experience in Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, Purchasing Cards, Corporate Cards, expense management, procurement operations or payment operations.
* Proven experience leading a multi\-market P\-Card or Corporate Card implementation, expansion or major transformation from design through stabilisation.
* Strong knowledge of the card lifecycle, issuer operations, expense management, settlement, reconciliation, accounting and exception handling.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating P\-Card governance, policies, transaction controls, approval limits, segregation of duties, fraud prevention and audit trails.
* Experience integrating card issuers and expense platforms with procurement, enterprise resource planning and finance systems, including testing and cutover management.
* Proven programme leadership across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Technology, Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal and external service providers.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, governance forums, vendors, risks, issues, budgets, benefits and implementation reporting in a complex global organisation.

title: Assistant Vice President - Transaction Reporting
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Assistant Vice President – Regulatory Transaction Reporting \& Data Services
   

  

**Department:** 
 Asset Management – Investment Operations / Reporting
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Asset Management Reporting and Data Services are responsible for the end\-to\-end integrity of the data lifecycle. This includes transforming validated investment, accounting, pricing, and reference data into accurate, timely, and compliant reports for clients, regulators, and internal stakeholders. The function ensures that regulatory transaction reporting (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC) is executed with precision while maintaining the robust data foundations required for institutional\-grade reporting.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The Assistant Vice President (AVP) serves as a strategic leader and dual\-function controller within the Regulatory Transaction Reporting (RTR) and Data Services ecosystem. The role is responsible for the governance, oversight, and continuous improvement of both the regulatory reporting framework and the underlying data management architecture.
   

  

 The AVP is accountable for ensuring the "Golden Source" of data is maintained, managing the full data lineage from ingestion to regulatory submission, and driving the strategic roadmap for data quality and reporting automation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Direct Responsibilities**
* Strategic Oversight: Lead the end\-to\-end delivery strategy for regulatory transaction reporting and the data services lifecycle, ensuring all global SLAs and multi\-jurisdictional requirements are met.
* Data Governance \& Integrity: Act as the primary authority for data quality; establish and enforce standards for data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and consistency across all reporting streams.
* Regulatory Control Authority: Direct the oversight of both direct production (SFTR, MiFID II) and outsourced/delegated reporting (EMIR, ASIC), ensuring rigorous control over 3rd party Service Providers and Clearing Brokers.
* Critical Escalation \& Incident Management: Serve as the senior point of contact for resolving complex regulatory discrepancies, systemic data breaks, and high\-priority reporting failures.
* Quality Assurance Framework: Define and implement enhanced control standards for transaction pairing, matching, UTI management, and master data reconciliation.


**Contributing Responsibilities**
* Leadership \& Talent Development: Provide strategic direction to Production Analysts and Data Processors; drive a culture of technical excellence, data literacy, and continuous professional development.
* Transformation \& Data Engineering Oversight: Lead large\-scale automation and digitalization projects; oversee the implementation of automated data validation rules and streamlined data ingestion workflows.
* Data Lineage \& Traceability: Partner with IT and Data Engineering to ensure full end\-to\-end data lineage, enabling seamless audit trails from regulatory submission back to the original source system.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Partner with senior leaders in Performance, Accounting, and Product teams to optimize upstream data flows and resolve systemic "root cause" issues.
* Audit \& Regulatory Liaison: Lead the response to internal/external audits and regulatory inquiries, ensuring all data controls, governance documentation, and oversight evidence are robust.
* Change Management: Drive the implementation of new regulatory requirements (e.g., EMIR Refit) and system enhancements across the global reporting and data landscape.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**
* Advanced Regulatory Reporting Mastery: Deep expertise in the mechanics of EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, and ASIC, including submission lifecycles and exception handling.
* Data Management \& Governance Expertise: Advanced understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), data sourcing, enrichment, and the management of investment data domains (Holdings, Pricing, Reference Data, Corporate Actions).
* Data Quality \& Analytics: Ability to design data quality dashboards and use statistical methods to monitor data health and identify emerging trends/risks.
* Systems \& Data Architecture: High\-level understanding of the end\-to\-end data pipeline, including the connectivity between source systems, data warehouses, and regulatory interfaces (ARMs/APAs/TRs).
* Risk \& Control Design: Advanced ability to design and implement complex control frameworks to mitigate operational, regulatory, and reputational risks.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strategic Leadership: Ability to lead diverse teams through complex regulatory shifts and inspire a culture of data\-driven accountability.
* Influencing \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and effectively challenge 3rd party service providers and brokers.
* Decisiveness under Pressure: Ability to make high\-stakes, time\-sensitive decisions regarding regulatory deadlines and data integrity.
* Problem\-Solving \& Innovation: A proactive approach to identifying systemic gaps in data/reporting logic and implementing long\-term technological solutions.
* High Accountability: Absolute ownership of the function’s regulatory standing, data accuracy, and global delivery quality.


**Specific Qualifications**
* Education: Post Graduate degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline (MBA/CFA preferred).
* Experience: Extensive experience (5\+ years) in Regulatory Transaction Reporting or Financial Data Management within an Asset Management or Sell\-side environment.
* Data Mastery: Proven track record in managing complex data flows, performing high\-level reconciliations, and validating data lineage and traceability.
* Leadership Track Record: Experience in managing operational teams and overseeing outsourced service providers/vendors.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Expert\-level understanding of the evolving global regulatory landscape (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Process Excellence: Demonstrated experience in leading process improvement, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.


**Skills Referential**
**Technical Skills:**
* Advanced Regulatory Frameworks (EMIR, SFTR, MiFID II, ASIC).
* Data Governance, Data Lineage, and Master Data Management (MDM) principles.
* Strategic Risk Management \& Control Design.
* Expert proficiency in Data Analysis tools (Advanced Excel, SQL/Python knowledge preferred) and Reporting Platforms (e.g., Aladdin, DTCC, Tri\-Optima).


**Behavioral Skills**
* Strategic Thinking \& Vision.
* Executive Communication (Reporting KPIs and trends to senior management).
* Change Leadership \& Transformation.
* Advanced Conflict Resolution \& Negotiation.
* Risk\-based Decision Making.


**Education Level:** 
 Post Graduate degree in Finance
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai

title: Finance - Team Head
description:
**Job Description\- Team Head, Finance Service Delivery** 




**Position Overview** 




 The Team Head\- Finance Service Delivery will have overall accountability for leading a high\-performing finance operations team and delivering accurate, timely, controlled and value\-focused services to clients. The incumbent will own service delivery, operational governance, financial controls, stakeholder engagement, risk management and continuous improvement. As the senior finance contact for the engagement, the role will be expected to anticipate client needs, resolve complex issues, drive service excellence and build a scalable delivery model. The position requires a qualified CA or CMA with substantial finance operations experience, strong commercial judgement and a proven record of leading teams in a demanding client\-service environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Service delivery ownership:** 
 Assume end\-to\-end accountability for the finance service portfolio, consistently meeting or exceeding service\-level, quality, accuracy and turnaround\-time commitments.
* **Client leadership:** 
 Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders, understand business priorities, provide transparent updates and build trusted, long\-term relationships.
* **Team leadership:** 
 Build, lead and retain a high\-performing finance team through clear accountability, effective work allocation, performance management, coaching, competency development, succession planning and adequate backup coverage.
* **Finance operations:** 
 Direct and review accounts payable, employee expenses, general ledger accounting, journal entries, account reconciliations, corporate card processing, month\-end close and suspense account management.
* **Financial control and risk:** 
 Establish and enforce a robust control environment covering approvals, supporting documentation, general ledger coding, segregation of duties, reconciliations, access controls and timely closure of exceptions.
* **Governance and reporting:** 
 Lead operational governance forums; review dashboards, ageing, capacity, productivity, quality and risk indicators; and present clear insights, decisions required and recovery plans to management and clients.
* **Escalation management:** 
 Take ownership of critical service issues and escalations, mobilize cross\-functional support, complete root\-cause analysis and ensure timely implementation of sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* **Transformation and value creation:** 
 Develop and execute a continuous\-improvement roadmap covering standardization, automation, digitization, productivity enhancement, cost efficiency and control strengthening.
* **Compliance and audit:** 
 Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax and regulatory requirements, internal policies and client procedures, including GST and withholding tax where relevant; lead timely closure of audit observations.
* **Transition and change:** 
 Lead migration and stabilization of new finance processes, including due diligence, process documentation, risk assessment, control design, knowledge transfer, resource planning and operational\-readiness sign\-off.
* **Cross\-functional partnership:** 
 Partner effectively with clients, auditors, tax, procurement, technology, treasury, vendors and other internal functions to deliver integrated solutions and timely decisions.



**Experience** 



* Minimum 15 year of relevant experience in finance and accounting, including at least 5 years in a leadership role with responsibility for people, controls and client service delivery.
* Demonstrated breadth across accounts payable, employee expenses, general ledger, reconciliations, month\-end close, management reporting, controls and audit support
* Strong track record of improving service performance, strengthening controls, managing senior stakeholders and delivering transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting a bank, financial institution or other highly regulated organization is strongly preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP, accounting, payment and expense platforms; experience with SAP, Oracle, SAP Concur and related workflow or reporting tools is desirable



  





**Competencies** 



* Strong executive presence, commercial judgement and confidence in engaging senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to build accountable teams, manage performance and create a strong culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving and decision\-making capability, including sound judgement under pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* High standards of integrity, accuracy, accountability and client confidentiality.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, complex change and demanding deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with strong capability in data interpretation and management reporting

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Anandha Inn Convention Centre and Suites is a four\-star luxury hotel located in the central area of Pondicherry, offering guests an elegant setting for relaxation and events. Established in 1994, the property blends traditional architectural elements with modern design and amenities. The hotel is surrounded by heritage sites, war memorials, Bharathi Park with its Greco\-Roman arches, and renowned local temples. Guests enjoy access to landscaped gardens featuring regional flowers and trees, creating a distinctive and tranquil atmosphere. This combination of cultural surroundings and contemporary comfort makes it a notable destination for both leisure stays and conventions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Revenue Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai, responsible for driving revenue performance across rooms, events, and ancillary services. This role involves monitoring daily bookings, analyzing demand patterns, and adjusting pricing and inventory strategies to maximize occupancy and revenue. The Revenue Manager will prepare regular revenue reports, support budgeting and forecasting, and ensure accurate revenue recognition in coordination with the finance and accounting teams. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with sales and marketing to develop promotions, evaluating distribution channels and online travel agency performance, and recommending strategy changes based on market trends and competitor analysis. The role also entails maintaining rate integrity, overseeing revenue\-related systems and tools, and supporting senior leadership with data\-driven insights for commercial decisions.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data\-driven recommendations.
* Proficiency in revenue management, including demand forecasting, pricing strategies, and inventory control.
* Solid understanding of finance and accounting principles, including accurate revenue recognition practices.
* Experience using hotel revenue management systems, PMS, and reporting tools; advanced Excel skills are an advantage.
* Relevant experience in hospitality or convention center revenue management is preferred.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with sales, marketing, and operations teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Hospitality Management, or a related field is preferred.

+ Deliver training, usage guidance, and change management to drive self\-service analytics.
+ Present insights and recommendations with clear storytelling.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4–7 years as a Business/Systems Analyst, including 2\+ years hands\-on with Power BI.

* Proficient SQL (joins, CTEs, window functions) and data profiling.
* Experience with BI lifecycle in Agile/Scrum environments (Jira/Azure DevOps/Confluence).
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Certifications: Microsoft PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), PSM/CSPO, IIBA CCBA/CBAP.
* Nice\-to\-have: Python/R for analytics, statistics, Power Automate/Power Apps, embedded analytics.
* Domain experience in \[BFSI/Healthcare/Retail/Manufacturing/etc.].


**Success Metrics (KPIs)**
- Report adoption and satisfaction (usage growth, NPS).

- Cycle time from request to deployment; backlog throughput.

- Data quality and refresh reliability; reduction in manual reporting hours.

 Performance benchmarks (e.g., \<3s median visual/DAX query time).
 - Self\-service enablement (share of certified datasets, reuse rate).

**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; MBA a plus.

title: AVP - Control Finance
description:
Join Barclays as AVP \- Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating it.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:
   

  

  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking \& Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include Below**
* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements \& practice e.g. Sarbanes\-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power\-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Chennai.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad\-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**About Company** 
 : Mobismart is a complete, end\-to\-end smart card solutions provider for the banking, retail, healthcare and telecom industries. Our efficiency, excellence and ethics make us an ideal choice for clients who require smart, secure solutions.
 



 Mobismart produces magnetic striped cards and smart cards, where the security element can have a contact, contactless or dual interface, with features customized as per the client’s needs and requirements. We also offer packaging and fulfillment services – with quick turnaround times and excellent customer service.
 



  





 Team Size: 2 People in the Accounts Department
 



 Position: Senior Accountant
 



  





**We are seeking an immediate candidate** 




  





**Responsibilities and Duties** 




  





 1\. Goods \& Services Tax (GST)
 



 1\.1\. Monthly Compliance
 


* File GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B on time.
* Perform GSTR\-2B reconciliation with books.
* Match output tax and input tax entries with the Electronic Credit Ledger.
* Reconcile bank entries relating to GST with the Electronic Cash Ledger.



 1\.2\. Annual Compliance
 


* Apply for Letter of Undertaking (LUT) once a year.
* File GSTR\-9 and GSTR\-9C annually.



 2\. Income Tax
 



 2\.1\. Annual
 


* Coordinate with statutory auditor for annual computation and tax audit filing.
* Perform final reconciliation before finalising financials.



 2\.2\. Quarterly
 


* Reconcile Form 26AS with books to confirm customers have given correct TDS credits.



 2\.3\. Monthly / Transaction\-wise
 


* Pass entries for TDS receivables on customer invoices to track correct credits.



 3\. Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) – Payables
 



 3\.1\. Annual
 


* File Form 13 in April for lower deduction certificate with required documentation.



 3\.2\. Quarterly
 


* File TDS returns accurately and on time.



 3\.3\. Monthly
 


* Make timely TDS payments.
* Reconcile TDS returns with books.
* Check TDS applicability on every payment before processing; do not process without confirmation.



 4\. Payroll, ESI \& PF
 



 4\.1\. Monthly Payroll Processing
 


* Verify correctness of Salary Data through HRMS Software; test 1–2 transactions monthly.
* Process payroll after all approvals.
* Prepare Excel workings to cross\-check software output.



 4\.2\. Attendance \& Leave
 


* Verify attendance software integration with payroll.
* Maintain leave balances as per statutory requirements.



 4\.3\. Statutory Payments \& Filings
 


* Make ESI and PF payments before due dates.
* File ESI and PF returns on time.
* Coordinate with consultant for UAN creation and ESI/PF portal issues.



 5\. Coordination with Consultant \& HR
 


* Ensure HR provides accurate data to Consultant for statutory register maintenance.
* Cross\-check accuracy of registers.



 6\. Banking
 



 6\.1\. Annual
 


* Submit documents in December for OCC and term loan renewal.



 6\.2\. Monthly \& Quarterly
 


* Provide monthly certificates for stock, receivables, and payables.
* Provide quarterly audited statements to bank.



 6\.3\. Ongoing
 


* Maintain sufficient OCC balance for EMI on 7th of every month; alert promoters if shortfall.
* Follow up on new banking facilities.
* Visit bank weekly for pending matters.
* Verify interest charged by bank; flag discrepancies.
* Notify management of idle funds for investment planning.



 7\. Management Information System (MIS)
 



 7\.1\. Daily
 


* Prepare customer\-wise and cumulative daily sales reports.
* Report outstanding receivables and payables.



 7\.2\. Monthly
 


* Prepare monthly P\&L and Balance Sheet with comparative figures:
* Current month vs same month previous year.
* Quarter\-to\-date vs same quarter previous year.
* Full year totals vs previous year.



 8\. SAP Implementation
 


* Coordinate with factory team for smooth implementation.



 9\. Daily Accounting, Invoicing \& Vendor Management
 



 9\.1\. Daily Accounting
 


* Pass all accounting entries (bank, sales, vendor).
* Match entries with bank and sales invoices.



 9\.2\. Invoicing
 


* Raise sales invoices daily without delay.
* Generate and upload e\-invoices as per GST rules.
* Generate and manage e\-way bills for all applicable dispatches.



 9\.3\. Vendor Invoices
 


* Save vendor invoices from email day\-wise.
* Cross\-check with inwards and purchase teams before booking.
* Book only if goods are accepted for production.



 9\.4\. Payments
 


* Make vendor payments strictly against invoices (no “on account” payments).
* Weekly: prepare vendor due list for payment.
* Coordinate with purchase team for payment scheduling.



 9\.5\. Expense \& Asset Accounting
 


* Ensure correct classification of expenses, income, and balance sheet items.
* Calculate monthly depreciation (annual depreciation ÷ 12\); final reconciliation annually.
* Record monthly stock values based on purchase price after finance head’s approval.



 10\. EPCG \& Advance Licence
 


* Coordinate for closure of EPCG and Advance Licence.
* Manage extensions where required.
* Follow up and complete pending eBRC.



 11\. Due Diligence \& Subsidy
 


* Provide data as per checklists to relevant teams during due diligence or subsidy processes.



 12\. Statutory Audit
 


* Provide necessary data to auditor and ensure timely closure of annual audit.



 13\. Company Secretary (CS)
 


* Ensure timely filing of all forms.
* Maintain and update statutory registers and minutes.
* Conduct quarterly board meetings.



 14\. Electricity Bill
 


* Make EB payments before due date.



 15\. Customer Payment Follow\-up
 


* Follow up with customers on due dates.



 16\. Promoter Loan Accounting
 


* Record promoter expenses as per bills submitted.
* Credit promoter loan account accordingly.



 17\. Accounts
 


* Raise purchase orders and invoices.
* Maintain books and pass daily entries.
* File GST, TDS, and annual IT returns.
* Ensure books are accurate and reconciled.



 18\. Bill of Entry (BOE) Processing
 


* Send BOEs to bank post\-goods receipt for payment knock\-off.
* Ensure no pending BOEs.



 19\. Duty Payment for Imports
 


* Initiate duty payment upon receipt of machines/foreign goods.
* Ensure timely payment.



 20\. Cash Flow Management
 


* Prepare weekly and monthly cash flow reports.
* Manage liquidity for operational needs.



  





**Required Experience, Skills and Qualifications** 




 BCom/MCom/ CA Inter/ICWA Inter/ ICMAI Inter
 



 Experience \- 5\-7 Years
 



 Office Location: Kelambakkam
